name: SearchField
title: SearchField
summary: A 48px search input with a magnifier on the left and a round clear button that appears once there is text.
whenToUse: Site search, FAQ filters, filtering a list already on the page.
whenNotToUse: Not for picking one value from a list: use Combobox (search + dropdown) or Select.
Not for the homepage Bible directory: use the hero Combobox.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Always give one; the placeholder is an example, not the label.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint under the field, for example "Press Enter to see results.". Replaced by `error`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (rare). Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and links it with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new text whenever it changes (typing, clear button, Esc).

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called with the current text when the form is submitted (Enter).

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

props.name: formClassName
props.description: Class on the outer `<form role="search">`. `className` goes on the input.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label above the field. Always provide one.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text under the field, e.g. "Press Enter to see results".

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called when the person presses Search/Enter on the keyboard, with the current text.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button.

variantNotes: Empty: placeholder in `--gray-placeholder`, no clear button.
Focus: base `.input` focus, `--horizon-blue` border plus `--shadow-focus`. Use `.fm-focus` only to draw it static in specs.
Error: rare; use `aria-invalid="true"` and an `.err` line under the field.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Always give the field a visible `.label`. The placeholder is an example, not the label.
Show the clear button only when the field has text; hide it with `hidden`.
Hide the browser's own cancel button; `.fm-sf` already does this.
Wrap in `<form role="search">` so Enter submits.
Keep the field 48px tall. On dark sections, place it on a white card; do not invert it.
The clear button is 32px visually; keep the whole field row at least 44px for touch.
